import subprocess, re
# Use pdfplumber-like raw scan to find on which page 'References' header first appears (as a real heading, not in body text)
out = subprocess.run(['pdftotext', '-layout', 'main.pdf', '-'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
pages = out.split('\f')
print(f"Total pages: {len(pages)}")
for i, page in enumerate(pages, 1):
    # Look for "References" as a section header (left-margin or appears as standalone line)
    for ln_no, ln in enumerate(page.split('\n')):
        stripped = ln.strip()
        if stripped == 'References' or stripped.startswith('References') and len(stripped) < 20:
            print(f"Page {i}, line {ln_no}: '{stripped[:60]}'")
            break
EOF
